name: Mattermost Professional
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Mattermost Professional, self-host team chat with channels, threads, search, and integrations. The hard boundary is managed operations, mobile push, enterprise security, support, and governance, plus network, moderation, and communication infrastructure.
